description: Plan and price a complete trip in one place. BreckenWander shows the all-in total — every mandatory tax and fee included — for flights, hotels, and experiences, and assembles them into one multi-part itinerary. Booking finishes in a single checkout on breckenwander.com, where BreckenWander is the merchant of record. Read-only in chat; no account needed.

defaultPrompt: Plan a 4-day Cancún trip: a flight from JFK, a beach hotel, and a food tour — show the total.
Find round-trip flights from JFK to Cancún for 2 adults, Aug 12–16, with the all-in price.
Show me 4-star hotels in Cancún for Aug 12–16 with taxes and fees included.
